one_month_reasoning: Qualcomm's fiscal Q4 FY26 report is most likely in the first week of November (last year's Q4 report came in early November; aggregators list Nov 4 or Nov 11, one lists Oct 29 unconfirmed), so the main scheduled catalyst most likely falls just outside the 2026-10-30 window. Inside the window: October FOMC (after a September hike, rate-sensitive tech sold off on rising yields on Sep 28), TSMC and Samsung Q3 results in mid/late October (read-through on memory pricing and 2nm foundry pricing talks that were cited in the Sep 28 drop), Apple's late-October results (handset demand read, license already renewed), and TrendForce's Sep 30 note that mobile DRAM prices keep rising in 4Q26 (continued handset headwind, already known). The stock just fell ~9% from $201.97 (Sep 25) to $184.47 after a 40% six-month run; short-horizon reversal and continued profit-taking roughly offset, so I stay close to a symmetric lognormal centred at ~$185 with monthly sigma ~13% (between long-run 39% and recent ~50% annualised vol divided by ~sqrt(12)), slightly wider than annual-vol/3.5 would give because of the elevated recent realized vol and small chance earnings lands on Oct 29.

fair_value.method: Blend of (a) FY2028-style NTM EPS at the horizon ~$10.5 x 17.5x forward P/E = $184 and (b) FY2027 consensus-range EPS ~$9.5 x the 10-year median trailing P/E ~19.9x = $189, weighted 60/40 = ~$186; net debt (~$7B, ~$6.5/share) is small and already reflected in EPS via interest.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS at Sep-2027 (mostly FY2028) ~$10.5 x 17.5x forward multiple

inputs_detail.derivation: Midpoint between TIKR normalized NTM EPS $9.30 (Sep 28, cut from $9.80) and the older 33-analyst FY27 average $10.22; weighted toward the fresher, lower TIKR number.

Consensus FY28 revenue ~$51.9B vs FY27 ~$44.9B implies strong top-line growth from data-center custom silicon and auto; haircut to ~10% EPS growth because IDC sees smartphone units still falling in 2027 (-1.1%) and memory costs staying high to mid-2027.

Current forward P/E ~18x (Sep 14) and NTM ~20x after estimate cuts; 10-yr median trailing P/E 19.9x which corresponds to ~16-18x forward. Used 17.5x: mid-cycle for a handset-heavy chip company with a nascent data-center option.

bear.story: Memory-driven handset slump persists through 2027 (IDC: units fall again in 2027), Apple modem share keeps shrinking, data-center custom silicon ramps slower than hoped and a 2027 recession (Polymarket 35%, Kalshi 24%) compresses semis multiples; EPS ~$9 x 14x, a replay of the 2022-23 handset downturn when QCOM fell ~40% peak to trough.

base.story: Handset trough in FY27 with QTL stabilized by the Apple license renewal; auto (+61% y/y last quarter) and first hyperscaler custom-silicon revenue from Dec-2026 deliver ~10% EPS growth into FY28; multiple ~17-18x forward.

bull.story: Data-center wins (two hyperscalers plus Amazon) convert to visible multi-billion revenue, non-handset targets ($5B FY27 data center, $40B non-handset by FY29) gain credibility, memory costs ease mid-2027; market re-rates toward the May-2026 peak (~$260) at ~22x FY28 EPS.

thesis_break_reason: Around $130 the stock would sit back at its March-2026 trough (~$122-129) and trade near 13-14x FY27 EPS, a level QCOM has only reached in handset recessions (2019, late 2022-23). Getting there would most likely mean the data-center custom-silicon ramp slipped or was cancelled and/or handset/QTL earnings broke below ~$8.5, not ordinary 40-50% volatility noise.

reasoning: Base-rate anchor: from 118 overlapping 12-month windows of QCOM monthly closes (Dec 2015-Sep 2026, Twelve Data), the 12m price-return distribution has 5th/25th/50th/75th/95th percentiles of -26%/-9%/+11%/+32%/+74%, with 65% of windows positive; that sample carries a strong secular up-drift (stock went from ~$50 to ~$184), so I shade the median down to ~+3%. Long-run annualised monthly-log vol is 39% vs ~50% over the last 24 months and 54% realized over the last year (inflated by the May-June 2026 spike to $260 and crash to $147), so I use a core sigma of 0.38 plus a 20% fat-tail component at 0.65 to reflect the stock's history of 40%+ moves (2019 Apple settlement +50% in a month, 2022-23 -40% drawdown, 2026 +100%/-43%). Fundamentals: FY27 EPS ~$9.3-10.2, falling (TIKR NTM EPS cut from $9.80 to $9.30 over three months) because memory costs are crushing handset units, offset by auto records and data-center orders; fair value ~$186 from 17.5x NTM EPS and the 10-year median P/E, essentially today's price, with Street mean targets ~$194-204 slightly above. Macro event odds: Polymarket 35% (Sep 24) and Kalshi 24% US recession by end-2027; Polymarket <1% for new semiconductor tariffs by Dec 31 (US-China tariff deal ~93%), so tariff tail risk is modest but recession risk is material. Result: median ~$189, P(>=184) ~0.53, with a fat left tail to the $120s (March 2026 trough) and a right tail to the prior $260 high. Research was limited to ~12 web queries; several pages (Benzinga, Kalshi, gurufocus, predictionnews) blocked fetching, so some figures come from search-result snippets.
